text:
maya: heads up — noticed the sampleapp (node) doubled a webhook when the API returned a 429 during onboarding tests today. reproducible with the surge-sim harness.

linus: ugh, seen that pattern before. is this the token-rotate + retry combo?

sam: yeah, looks like token rotation race + immediate retry. node lib retries before the new token is attached to the outgoing request, ends up replaying the side-effect.

maya: steps to repro (short):
1) start sampleapp and auth refresher (short TTL)
2) trigger burst -> 429
3) SDK auto-retry kicks in while auth rotates -> duplicate webhook sent

joel: can we add a small client-side replay guard (idempotency-key) in the sampleapp until SDK parity is fixed? cheap fix.

linus: +1. python already has `Idempotency-Key` helper in client, node doesn't. we should avoid shipping long-term hacks in sampleapp though — but as a stopgap it's fine.

maya: proposal:
- sampleapp: set `Idempotency-Key` per user-action for all webhook posts (stopgap)
- SDK: unify behavior: attach current token to the retry path before re-sending; ensure retries honor auth refresh lifecycle
- telemetry: emit `dup_detected` when server responds with dedupe header or when we see repeated side-effect idempotency keys

sam: +1. also add jittered backoff default in node where we saw pure immediate retry. something like:
```js
// exponential backoff w/ full jitter
const base = 100; // ms
const attempt = n;
const max = 2000; // ms
const sleep = Math.min(max, base * 2 ** attempt);
const jitter = Math.random() * sleep;
await delay(jitter);
```

joel: if we add idempotency-keys to sampleapp, include header format `Idempotency-Key: <action>-<user>-<uuid>` so server-side logs can correlate.

maya: note: server already accepts that header and logs `x-idempotency-hit: true` when it dedupes. we can rely on it for test assertions.

linus: action items:
- linus: add node SDK retry fix (ensure token swap is atomic w/ retry) — PR by EOD?
- maya: update sampleapp to send Idempotency-Key and jittered backoff in node sample, add test harness assertion
- sam: add dedupe telemetry + dashboard tile (count and latency buckets)

joel: small API nuance — when servers return 429 we should include `Retry-After` handling as a floor but still jitter around it. some clients ignore Retry-After which makes surges worse.

maya: agree. sampleapp will respect `Retry-After` if provided, otherwise uses base jitter policy.

sam: flagged a follow-up: we need an SDK-level flag `allow_unsafe_replay` (default false) so advanced customers can choose behavior. don't expose as true by default.

linus: working on node changes now. quick q: do we want to push idempotency header into core request layer or keep it in high-level helpers?

maya: keep in high-level helpers for now — core layer should not invent application-level keys. but add an API hook so libs/apps can supply `idempotencyKey()` and core will attach it consistently during retries.

ci-bot: build queued: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/12345 — node-sdk-retry-fix pipeline started :gear: (will report status)

joel: once node PR lands we should run surge-sim (local) and run full e2e against sampleapp to validate no duplicates in 10k simulated actions.

maya: created draft PR for sampleapp: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/321 (adds idempotency keys + backoff). please review.

sam: added dashboard card stub: /dashboards/dup-detection — will wire events after SDK emits telemetry.

linus: CI reported a flake in auth-mock after I pushed token-swap atomic changes, investigating (might be test ordering).

maya: thanks team. follow-up check-in tomorrow after the node PR and sampleapp CI. :thumbsup:

joel: small note for docs: add quick blurb in "retry best practices" that recommends idempotency-key for side-effectful endpoints and shows safe header format + backoff snippet.

maya: adding doc TODO to devex docs board.

sam: if anyone hits a customer repro, tag me — I can temporarily flip telemetry to debug live duplication counts.

linus: CI green, pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/210 — request review.

maya: merging sampleapp patch after tests pass. thanks all. :party:
